note: Fallback copy of the fixed stage contract, used only until content/stages.json is published. Delete this file when it lands.

stages.name: Frame
stages.question: Is this worth building, and what would prove it?

stages.name: Pilot
stages.question: Does it work on real data, measured honestly?

stages.name: Launch
stages.question: Can we ship it safely to real users?

stages.name: Scale
stages.question: Can it grow in users, agents and cost without losing control?

stages.name: Operate
stages.question: Can we see, fix and improve it in production?

stages.name: Govern
stages.question: Who is accountable, and can we prove it?
